candidates.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. This input is an exact orthographic production geometry blockout, NOT a mood image. Materialize it as a realistic hand-crafted ancient southern Xinjiang oasis-town map sprite. Preserve the input camera, framing, every major outer boundary and especially the three lowest footprint corners PIXEL EXACTLY. Do NOT rotate, re-project, tilt, enlarge, narrow, or reposition the blockout. Its ground axes are exactly +0.5 and -0.5 slopes, yaw45 elevation30, required for grid assembly. Add fine weathered ochre adobe, local pale stone foundation, honest timber grain and carved wood screens. Restrained highly detailed realistic historic strategy-game art; no plastic/toy look. Upper-left light, tiny lower-right contact shadow. Keep real transparent RGBA outside silhouette. No text, numbers, guide marks, border, watermark, people, animals, modern objects, landscape, or thick floating display slab. Ground is a flat thin contact surface. All new detail stays WITHIN the guide silhouette. Footprint front-to-side lengths exactly 12:9. Make a two-storey adobe tea house. Preserve exact outside boundaries of large flat-roof main block. Front long low block becomes ground-floor timber colonnade, upstairs wooden balcony directly above it: use carving/recesses inside that block, no changes to ground silhouette. Tiny tea tables and cups within arcade, plain muted rust fabric shade above windows, low roof parapet. Lowest vertices left(208,580), front(848,900), right(1328,660).
